answer: The most convincing sybil defense binds each agent identity to a nonce-chained work ledger: every task records the hash of the previous one in a shared verification grove. Reputation and escrow attach to this chain, so a trusted identity cannot be forked into parallel copies without breaking continuity; forks restart at zero reputation and re-lock collateral. The coordinator bridge requires the full nonce sequence, so clones get rejected. Attacker cost: months of serialized work plus stake per identity, and violet-flagged clones get slashed.
